Package com.im.njams.sdk.settings

Class HierarchicalSettings.FilterableLayerBuilder

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.settings.HierarchicalSettings.FilterableLayerBuilder
  • Enclosing class:
    HierarchicalSettings
    public static final class HierarchicalSettings.FilterableLayerBuilder
extends Object
    Extension of the builder chain returned after HierarchicalSettings.Builder.andThenSystemProperties() or HierarchicalSettings.Builder.andThenEnvironmentVariables(). Adds prefix and regex filter configuration for the most recently added system/environment layer; otherwise mirrors HierarchicalSettings.Builder. Filters configured via withPrefixFilter(String) and withRegexFilter(String) combine with AND semantics — a key passes only if it satisfies both. Filters are applied to the storage key (the actual system-property name or environment-variable name).
